TIPS FOR BEST RESULTS
  1. Allow precise location when your browser asks, and keep this page open with the screen on. Tap Awake so it doesn't lock.
  2. Walk in the open. GPS drifts next to tall buildings and under bridges. If a stop doesn't trigger, step a few metres toward open sky.
  3. Use the compass flat. Hold your phone level, screen up, top edge pointing ahead. Tilted phones give a wrong direction.
  4. Metal confuses it. If the arrows seem off, step away from cars and railings and wave the phone in a figure-8.
  5. Headphones help. Narration plays through your phone's speaker unless you plug in.
